It doesn't work unless I press very hard on the key. Several other Mac owners have reported a similar issue with their butterfly keyboards. For the rest of this short post, I will not correct any typographical errors related to the letter "G," and I'll embolden the affected words to show what happens when Apple's butterfly keyboard becomes defective, startin now.
